  const TRACK_NAMES = {
    'gestao': 'Gestão & Organizações',
    'politicas': 'Políticas Públicas & Avaliação',
    'sociedade': 'Ciência Política & Direito',
    'economia': 'Economia & Finanças Públicas',
    'metodos': 'Metodologia & Métodos Quantitativos',
    'pratica': 'Prática Profissional & TCC'
  };

  const grafoSvg = document.getElementById('cagp-grafo-svg');
  const colsGroup = document.getElementById('grafo-cols');
  const linksGroup = document.getElementById('grafo-links');
  const nodesGroup = document.getElementById('grafo-nodes');
  const indicator = document.getElementById('grafo-active-indicator');
  const resetGrafoBtn = document.getElementById('btn-grafo-reset');
  const detailDrawer = document.getElementById('grafo-detail-drawer');
  const closeDetailBtn = document.getElementById('btn-close-detail');
  const trilhaBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-trilha-filter]');

  let selectedNodeId = null;
  let activeTrilha = 'all';

  function getColX(col) {
    return 15 + (col - 1) * 118;
  }

  function initGrafo() {
    if (!grafoSvg || !colsGroup || !linksGroup || !nodesGroup) return;

    // Renderizar colunas (10 semestres)
    for (let c = 1; c <= 10; c++) {
      const cx = getColX(c);
      const bg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
      bg.setAttribute('class', 'grafo-col-bg');
      bg.setAttribute('x', cx - 4);
      bg.setAttribute('y', 15);
      bg.setAttribute('width', 112);
      bg.setAttribute('height', 570);
      bg.setAttribute('rx', '4');
      colsGroup.appendChild(bg);

      const header = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      header.setAttribute('class', 'grafo-col-header');
      header.setAttribute('x', cx + 52);
      header.setAttribute('y', 34);
      header.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
      header.textContent = c + 'º PERÍODO';
      colsGroup.appendChild(header);
    }

    // Renderizar Conexões (Links SVG)
    Object.keys(DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO).forEach(function (fromId) {
      const fromDisc = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[fromId];
      const fromX = getColX(fromDisc.col) + 104;
      const fromY = fromDisc.y + 37;

      // 1. Links Formais (Trava no SIGA)
      fromDisc.formalUnlocks.forEach(function (toId) {
        const toDisc = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[toId];
        if (!toDisc) return;
        const toX = getColX(toDisc.col);
        const toY = toDisc.y + 37;

        const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
        const dx = Math.max(25, (toX - fromX) * 0.45);
        const d = `M ${fromX} ${fromY} C ${fromX + dx} ${fromY}, ${toX - dx} ${toY}, ${toX} ${toY}`;
        path.setAttribute('d', d);
        path.setAttribute('class', `grafo-link link-formal link-from-${fromId} link-to-${toId}`);
        path.setAttribute('id', `link-${fromId}-${toId}`);
        path.setAttribute('data-from', fromId);
        path.setAttribute('data-to', toId);
        path.setAttribute('data-is-formal', 'true');
        path.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-formal)');
        linksGroup.appendChild(path);
      });

      // 2. Links Sugeridos (Encadeamento Pedagógico Recomendado)
      fromDisc.suggestedUnlocks.forEach(function (toId) {
        const toDisc = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[toId];
        if (!toDisc) return;
        const toX = getColX(toDisc.col);
        const toY = toDisc.y + 37;

        const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
        const dx = Math.max(25, (toX - fromX) * 0.45);
        const d = `M ${fromX} ${fromY} C ${fromX + dx} ${fromY}, ${toX - dx} ${toY}, ${toX} ${toY}`;
        path.setAttribute('d', d);
        path.setAttribute('class', `grafo-link link-sugerido link-from-${fromId} link-to-${toId}`);
        path.setAttribute('id', `link-${fromId}-${toId}`);
        path.setAttribute('data-from', fromId);
        path.setAttribute('data-to', toId);
        path.setAttribute('data-is-formal', 'false');
        path.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-default)');
        linksGroup.appendChild(path);
      });
    });

    // Renderizar Nós (Disciplinas) com Roving Tabindex
    const nodeIds = Object.keys(DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO);
    nodeIds.forEach(function (id, idx) {
      const d = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[id];
      const x = getColX(d.col);
      const y = d.y;

      const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g');
      g.setAttribute('class', `grafo-node node-track-${d.track}${d.isFormalLock ? ' has-formal-lock' : ''}`);
      g.setAttribute('id', `node-${id}`);
      g.setAttribute('data-id', id);
      g.setAttribute('data-track', d.track);
      g.setAttribute('tabindex', idx === 0 ? '0' : '-1');
      g.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      g.setAttribute('aria-label', `${d.code}: ${d.name} (${d.period}º Período). Clique para ver detalhes e conexões.`);

      // Card retangular
      const card = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
      card.setAttribute('class', 'node-card');
      card.setAttribute('x', x);
      card.setAttribute('y', y);
      card.setAttribute('width', '104');
      card.setAttribute('height', '74');
      g.appendChild(card);

      // Badge superior
      if (d.isFormalLock) {
        const lockBadge = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
        lockBadge.setAttribute('class', 'node-lock-badge');
        lockBadge.setAttribute('x', x + 58);
        lockBadge.setAttribute('y', y + 6);
        lockBadge.setAttribute('width', '40');
        lockBadge.setAttribute('height', '13');
        g.appendChild(lockBadge);

        const lockText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        lockText.setAttribute('class', 'node-lock-text');
        lockText.setAttribute('x', x + 78);
        lockText.setAttribute('y', y + 15.5);
        lockText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
        lockText.textContent = 'TRAVA';
        g.appendChild(lockText);
      } else {
        const badge = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
        badge.setAttribute('class', 'node-badge');
        badge.setAttribute('x', x + 68);
        badge.setAttribute('y', y + 6);
        badge.setAttribute('width', '30');
        badge.setAttribute('height', '13');
        if (d.dept === 'DCP') badge.style.fill = 'var(--cagp-red, #9E2424)';
        else if (d.dept === 'ECN') badge.style.fill = '#111111';
        else if (d.dept === 'SOA') badge.style.fill = '#2E7D32';
        else if (d.dept === 'EST') badge.style.fill = '#1565C0';
        g.appendChild(badge);

        const badgeText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
        badgeText.setAttribute('class', 'node-badge-text');
        badgeText.setAttribute('x', x + 83);
        badgeText.setAttribute('y', y + 15.5);
        badgeText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
        badgeText.textContent = d.dept;
        g.appendChild(badgeText);
      }

      // Código
      const codeText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      codeText.setAttribute('class', 'node-code');
      codeText.setAttribute('x', x + 6);
      codeText.setAttribute('y', y + 16);
      codeText.textContent = d.code;
      g.appendChild(codeText);

      // Nome da Disciplina (1 ou 2 linhas reais)
      const nameText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      nameText.setAttribute('class', 'node-name');
      if (d.lines.length === 1) {
        nameText.setAttribute('x', x + 6);
        nameText.setAttribute('y', y + 36);
        nameText.textContent = d.lines[0];
      } else {
        nameText.setAttribute('x', x + 6);
        nameText.setAttribute('y', y + 32);
        const tspan1 = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'tspan');
        tspan1.setAttribute('x', x + 6);
        tspan1.setAttribute('dy', '0');
        tspan1.textContent = d.lines[0];
        nameText.appendChild(tspan1);

        const tspan2 = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'tspan');
        tspan2.setAttribute('x', x + 6);
        tspan2.setAttribute('dy', '11');
        tspan2.textContent = d.lines[1];
        nameText.appendChild(tspan2);
      }
      g.appendChild(nameText);

      // Rodapé do card: Carga Horária e Status
      const metaLeft = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      metaLeft.setAttribute('class', 'node-meta');
      metaLeft.setAttribute('x', x + 6);
      metaLeft.setAttribute('y', y + 64);
      metaLeft.setAttribute('fill', '#6b7280');
      metaLeft.textContent = `${d.period}ºP • ${d.ch}h`;
      g.appendChild(metaLeft);

      const metaRight = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
      metaRight.setAttribute('class', 'node-meta');
      metaRight.setAttribute('x', x + 98);
      metaRight.setAttribute('y', y + 64);
      metaRight.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'end');
      if (d.isFormalLock) {
        metaRight.setAttribute('fill', '#9e2424');
        metaRight.setAttribute('font-weight', '700');
        metaRight.textContent = 'Trava SIGA';
      } else {
        metaRight.setAttribute('fill', '#059669');
        metaRight.textContent = '✓ Aberto';
      }
      g.appendChild(metaRight);

      // Listeners de clique e teclado com Roving Tabindex
      function focusNode(targetId) {
        nodeIds.forEach(function (nid) {
          const nodeEl = document.getElementById('node-' + nid);
          if (nodeEl) {
            nodeEl.setAttribute('tabindex', nid === targetId ? '0' : '-1');
          }
        });
        const targetEl = document.getElementById('node-' + targetId);
        if (targetEl) targetEl.focus();
      }

      g.addEventListener('click', function () {
        focusNode(id);
        toggleSelectNode(id);
      });
      g.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggleSelectNode(id);
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
          e.preventDefault();
          const nextIdx = (idx + 1) % nodeIds.length;
          focusNode(nodeIds[nextIdx]);
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          e.preventDefault();
          const prevIdx = (idx - 1 + nodeIds.length) % nodeIds.length;
          focusNode(nodeIds[prevIdx]);
        }
      });

      nodesGroup.appendChild(g);
    });
  }

  function toggleSelectNode(id) {
    if (selectedNodeId === id) {
      clearSelection();
    } else {
      selectNode(id);
    }
  }

  function selectNode(id) {
    selectedNodeId = id;
    const d = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[id];
    if (!d) return;

    // Reset de classes prévias
    const allNodes = Array.from(nodesGroup.querySelectorAll('.grafo-node'));
    const allLinks = Array.from(linksGroup.querySelectorAll('.grafo-link'));

    allNodes.forEach(function (n) {
      n.classList.remove('is-selected', 'is-prereq', 'is-unlocked', 'is-dimmed');
      n.classList.add('is-dimmed');
    });

    allLinks.forEach(function (l) {
      l.classList.remove('is-active-req', 'is-active-next', 'is-dimmed');
      l.classList.add('is-dimmed');
      const isFormal = l.getAttribute('data-is-formal') === 'true';
      l.setAttribute('marker-end', isFormal ? 'url(#arrow-formal)' : 'url(#arrow-default)');
    });

    // Marcar nó selecionado
    const selectedNode = document.getElementById(`node-${id}`);
    if (selectedNode) {
      selectedNode.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
      selectedNode.classList.add('is-selected');
    }

    // Marcar pré-requisitos formais (Upstream)
    d.formalReqs.forEach(function (reqId) {
      const reqNode = document.getElementById(`node-${reqId}`);
      if (reqNode) {
        reqNode.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        reqNode.classList.add('is-prereq');
      }
      const link = document.getElementById(`link-${reqId}-${id}`);
      if (link) {
        link.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        link.classList.add('is-active-req');
        link.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-formal)');
      }
    });

    // Marcar encadeamentos sugeridos anteriores (Upstream)
    d.suggestedReqs.forEach(function (reqId) {
      const reqNode = document.getElementById(`node-${reqId}`);
      if (reqNode) {
        reqNode.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        reqNode.classList.add('is-prereq');
      }
      const link = document.getElementById(`link-${reqId}-${id}`);
      if (link) {
        link.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        link.classList.add('is-active-req');
        link.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-req)');
      }
    });

    // Marcar destravadas formais (Downstream)
    d.formalUnlocks.forEach(function (nextId) {
      const nextNode = document.getElementById(`node-${nextId}`);
      if (nextNode) {
        nextNode.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        nextNode.classList.add('is-unlocked');
      }
      const link = document.getElementById(`link-${id}-${nextId}`);
      if (link) {
        link.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        link.classList.add('is-active-next');
        link.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-formal)');
      }
    });

    // Marcar destravadas sugeridas (Downstream)
    d.suggestedUnlocks.forEach(function (nextId) {
      const nextNode = document.getElementById(`node-${nextId}`);
      if (nextNode) {
        nextNode.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        nextNode.classList.add('is-unlocked');
      }
      const link = document.getElementById(`link-${id}-${nextId}`);
      if (link) {
        link.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        link.classList.add('is-active-next');
        link.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrow-next)');
      }
    });

    // Atualizar indicador
    if (indicator) {
      if (d.isFormalLock) {
        indicator.innerHTML = `<strong>${d.code}:</strong> <i class="bi bi-lock-fill me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>Pré-requisito Formal no SIGA: ECN 140`;
      } else if (d.formalUnlocks.length > 0) {
        indicator.innerHTML = `<strong>${d.code}:</strong> <i class="bi bi-key-fill me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>Chave de destravamento formal de ECN 044 no SIGA`;
      } else {
        const totalReqs = d.suggestedReqs.length;
        const totalUnlocks = d.suggestedUnlocks.length;
        indicator.innerHTML = `<strong>${d.code}:</strong> ${totalReqs} base(s) sugerida(s) &bull; ${totalUnlocks} desdobramento(s)`;
      }
    }
    if (resetGrafoBtn) resetGrafoBtn.disabled = false;

    // Atualizar Drawer de Detalhes
    renderDetailDrawer(id);
  }

  function clearSelection() {
    selectedNodeId = null;
    const allNodes = Array.from(nodesGroup.querySelectorAll('.grafo-node'));
    const allLinks = Array.from(linksGroup.querySelectorAll('.grafo-link'));

    allNodes.forEach(function (n) {
      n.classList.remove('is-selected', 'is-prereq', 'is-unlocked');
      if (activeTrilha === 'all') {
        n.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
      } else {
        const track = n.getAttribute('data-track');
        n.classList.toggle('is-dimmed', track !== activeTrilha);
      }
    });

    allLinks.forEach(function (l) {
      l.classList.remove('is-active-req', 'is-active-next', 'is-dimmed');
      const isFormal = l.getAttribute('data-is-formal') === 'true';
      l.setAttribute('marker-end', isFormal ? 'url(#arrow-formal)' : 'url(#arrow-default)');
    });

    if (indicator) {
      indicator.textContent = 'Clique em uma disciplina para mapear conexões';
    }
    if (resetGrafoBtn) resetGrafoBtn.disabled = true;
    if (detailDrawer) detailDrawer.style.display = 'none';
  }

  function openDisciplineBottomSheet(codeKey) {
    if (!window.cagpSheet) return;
    const cleanKey = (codeKey || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
    const grafoData = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[cleanKey];
    let discCard = null;
    allDisciplines.concat(optCards).forEach(function (card) {
      if (extractDiscCode(card) === cleanKey) discCard = card;
    });

    const isObrig = Boolean(grafoData);
    const title = grafoData
      ? grafoData.code + ': ' + grafoData.name
      : (discCard && discCard.querySelector('summary strong') ? discCard.querySelector('summary strong').textContent.trim() : cleanKey);
    const ementaBodyEl = discCard ? discCard.querySelector('.cagp-discipline-body p') : null;
    const fullEmentaHtml = ementaBodyEl ? ementaBodyEl.innerHTML : (grafoData ? '<strong>Resumo da Ementa:</strong> ' + grafoData.desc : '');

    let metaBadge = isObrig
      ? grafoData.period + 'º Período • ' + grafoData.ch + 'h (' + grafoData.cr + ' cr)'
      : 'Disciplina Optativa • 60h (4 cr)';

    const isDone = gradeState.completed.indexOf(cleanKey) !== -1;
    const isFav = gradeState.favorites.indexOf(cleanKey) !== -1;

    let sigaAlertHtml = '';
    if (grafoData) {
      if (grafoData.isFormalLock) {
        sigaAlertHtml = '<div class="p-2 border border-2 border-dark bg-light mb-3 small"><strong class="text-danger"><i class="bi bi-lock-fill me-1"></i>Trava Formal no SIGA:</strong> Exige aprovação prévia em <strong>ECN 140 (Introdução à Economia)</strong>.</div>';
      } else if (grafoData.formalUnlocks && grafoData.formalUnlocks.length > 0) {
        sigaAlertHtml = '<div class="p-2 border border-2 border-dark bg-light mb-3 small"><strong class="text-danger"><i class="bi bi-key-fill me-1"></i>Chave no SIGA:</strong> Libera matrícula em <strong>ECN 044 (Economia do Bem-Estar)</strong>.</div>';
      } else {
        sigaAlertHtml = '<div class="p-2 border border-2 border-dark bg-light mb-3 small"><strong class="text-success"><i class="bi bi-unlock-fill me-1"></i>Matrícula Destravada no SIGA:</strong> Sem bloqueio automático no sistema.</div>';
      }
    }

    const html =
      '<div class="cagp-surface-low p-3 border border-2 border-dark mb-3">' +
        '<div class="small fw-bold text-uppercase text-danger mb-1">' + metaBadge + '</div>' +
        '<div class="small text-dark">' + fullEmentaHtml + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      sigaAlertHtml;

    const actionBtnHtml = isObrig
      ? '<button type="button" class="cagp-btn ' + (isDone ? 'cagp-btn-outline' : 'cagp-btn-primary') + ' btn-sm" onclick="window.cagpToggleGradeCompleted(\'' + cleanKey + '\'); window.cagpOpenDiscSheet(\'' + cleanKey + '\');">' +
          '<i class="bi ' + (isDone ? 'bi-check2-circle' : 'bi-plus-circle') + ' me-1"></i>' +
          (isDone ? 'Já Cursada ✓ (Toque p/ Desmarcar)' : 'Marcar como Já Cursada ✓') +
        '</button>'
      : '<button type="button" class="cagp-btn ' + (isFav ? 'cagp-btn-outline' : 'cagp-btn-primary') + ' btn-sm" onclick="window.cagpToggleGradeFav(\'' + cleanKey + '\'); window.cagpOpenDiscSheet(\'' + cleanKey + '\');">' +
          '<i class="bi ' + (isFav ? 'bi-star-fill text-warning' : 'bi-star') + ' me-1"></i>' +
          (isFav ? 'Optativa Favorita ★ (Desmarcar)' : 'Salvar nas Favoritas ★') +
        '</button>';

    const shareBtnHtml =
      '<button type="button" class="cagp-btn cagp-btn-outline btn-sm" data-cagp-share="true" ' +
        'data-share-title="' + title.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + ' • Gestão Pública UFMG" ' +
        'data-share-text="Confira a ementa oficial de ' + title.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + ' (' + metaBadge + ') no Super App CAGP UFMG:" ' +
        'data-share-url="percurso.html#explorador-grade">' +
        '<i class="bi bi-share me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i> Compartilhar' +
      '</button>';

    window.cagpSheet.open({
      title: title,
      badge: isObrig ? 'OBRIGATÓRIA' : 'OPTATIVA PPC',
      detent: 'medium',
      html: html,
      footerHtml: actionBtnHtml + shareBtnHtml + '<button type="button" class="cagp-btn cagp-btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="window.cagpSheet.close()">Fechar</button>'
    });
  }

  window.cagpOpenDiscSheet = openDisciplineBottomSheet;

  function renderDetailDrawer(id) {
    if (!detailDrawer) return;
    const d = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[id];
    if (!d) return;

    const codeBadge = document.getElementById('detail-code-badge');
    const deptBadge = document.getElementById('detail-dept-badge');
    const trackBadge = document.getElementById('detail-track-badge');
    const periodText = document.getElementById('detail-period');
    const titleText = document.getElementById('detail-title');
    const descText = document.getElementById('detail-desc');
    const jumpBtn = document.getElementById('btn-jump-ementa');
    const toggleCompBtn = document.getElementById('btn-detail-toggle-completed');
    const openSheetBtn = document.getElementById('btn-detail-open-sheet');
    const sigaBox = document.getElementById('detail-siga-box');
    const reqsList = document.getElementById('detail-reqs-list');
    const reqsNote = document.getElementById('detail-reqs-note');
    const unlocksList = document.getElementById('detail-unlocks-list');

    if (codeBadge) codeBadge.textContent = d.code;
    if (deptBadge) {
      deptBadge.textContent = d.dept;
      deptBadge.className = `cagp-badge badge-${d.dept.toLowerCase()} me-1`;
    }
    if (trackBadge) {
      trackBadge.textContent = d.trackLabel || TRACK_NAMES[d.track] || d.track;
    }
    if (periodText) {
      periodText.textContent = `${d.period}º Período • ${d.ch} horas (${d.cr} créditos)`;
    }
    if (titleText) {
      titleText.textContent = `${d.code}: ${d.name}`;
    }
    if (descText) {
      descText.textContent = d.desc;
    }

    if (toggleCompBtn) {
      const isDone = gradeState.completed.indexOf(id) !== -1;
      toggleCompBtn.classList.toggle('is-completed', isDone);
      toggleCompBtn.innerHTML = isDone
        ? '<i class="bi bi-check2-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> Já Cursada ✓'
        : '<i class="bi bi-check2-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> Marcar como Já Cursada';
      toggleCompBtn.onclick = function () {
        window.cagpToggleGradeCompleted(id);
        renderDetailDrawer(id);
      };
    }

    if (openSheetBtn) {
      openSheetBtn.onclick = function () {
        openDisciplineBottomSheet(id);
      };
    }

    // Box 1: Status no SIGA (sem side-tab border-left)
    if (sigaBox) {
      sigaBox.style.borderLeft = '';
      if (d.isFormalLock) {
        sigaBox.innerHTML = `
          <div class="small fw-bold text-danger mb-1">
            <i class="bi bi-lock-fill me-1"></i> Pré-Requisito Formal no SIGA (Trava de Matrícula):
          </div>
          <div class="small fw-semibold text-dark mb-1">
            <button type="button" class="cagp-preset-btn mb-1 text-danger border-danger" onclick="window.cagpSelectGrafoNode('ECN140')">
              <i class="bi bi-lock-fill me-1"></i>ECN 140 — Introdução à Economia
            </button>
          </div>
          <div class="small text-muted"><strong>Bloqueio no Sistema:</strong> Esta é a <strong>única matéria do curso com trava de matrícula cadastrada no SIGA</strong>. O sistema bloqueia a inscrição caso você não tenha aprovação prévia em Introdução à Economia.</div>
        `;
      } else if (d.formalUnlocks && d.formalUnlocks.length > 0) {
        sigaBox.innerHTML = `
          <div class="small fw-bold text-danger mb-1">
            <i class="bi bi-key-fill me-1"></i> Chave Formal de Destravamento no SIGA:
          </div>
          <div class="small text-dark mb-1">
            Aprovação formalmente obrigatória para liberar a matrícula em:
            ${d.formalUnlocks.map(function (uId) {
              const uDisc = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[uId];
              return `<button type="button" class="cagp-preset-btn mb-1 ms-1 text-danger border-danger" onclick="window.cagpSelectGrafoNode('${uId}')"><i class="bi bi-lock-fill me-1"></i>${uDisc ? uDisc.code + ' (' + uDisc.name + ')' : uId}</button>`;
            }).join('')}
          </div>
          <div class="small text-muted">Aprovação nesta matéria é exigência estrita do Colegiado para que o SIGA libere o acesso a Economia do Bem-Estar (ECN 044).</div>
        `;
      } else {
        sigaBox.innerHTML = `
          <div class="small fw-bold text-success mb-1">
            <i class="bi bi-unlock-fill me-1"></i> Status no SIGA: Matrícula Destravada
          </div>
          <div class="small text-muted">Esta disciplina <strong>não possui pré-requisito formal no sistema</strong>. O SIGA não barra a sua inscrição, mesmo que você decida cursá-la fora da ordem recomendada.</div>
        `;
      }
    }

    // Box 2: Encadeamento Pedagógico Sugerido (Anterior)
    if (reqsList) {
      if (d.suggestedReqs.length === 0) {
        reqsList.innerHTML = '<span class="text-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle me-1"></i>Disciplina introdutória ou sem encadeamento conceitual direto prévio.</span>';
        if (reqsNote) reqsNote.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        reqsList.innerHTML = d.suggestedReqs.map(function (reqId) {
          const reqDisc = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[reqId];
          return `<button type="button" class="cagp-preset-btn mb-1 me-1" onclick="window.cagpSelectGrafoNode('${reqId}')"><i class="bi bi-arrow-left-short"></i>${reqDisc ? reqDisc.code + ' (' + reqDisc.name + ')' : reqId}</button>`;
        }).join('');
        if (reqsNote) reqsNote.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }

    // Box 3: Desdobramentos Curriculares a Seguir
    if (unlocksList) {
      if (d.suggestedUnlocks.length === 0) {
        unlocksList.innerHTML = '<span class="text-muted">Não é base pedagógica direta de nenhuma matéria obrigatória subsequente.</span>';
      } else {
        unlocksList.innerHTML = d.suggestedUnlocks.map(function (nextId) {
          const nextDisc = DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[nextId];
          return `<button type="button" class="cagp-preset-btn mb-1 me-1" onclick="window.cagpSelectGrafoNode('${nextId}')"><i class="bi bi-arrow-right-short"></i>${nextDisc ? nextDisc.code + ' (' + nextDisc.name + ')' : nextId}</button>`;
        }).join('');
      }
    }

    // Botão de pular até o card da ementa oficial
    if (jumpBtn) {
      jumpBtn.onclick = function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (window.cagpActivateWorkspaceView) {
          window.cagpActivateWorkspaceView(null, 'v2', { updateHash: false });
        }
        const detailsCards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cagp-discipline'));
        const targetCard = detailsCards.find(function (c) {
          return (c.textContent || '').includes(d.code);
        });
        if (targetCard) {
          targetCard.open = true;
          targetCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
          targetCard.style.outline = '3px solid var(--cagp-red, #9E2424)';
          setTimeout(function () { targetCard.style.outline = 'none'; }, 2000);
        } else {
          const expSection = document.getElementById('explorador-grade');
          if (expSection) expSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      };
    }

    detailDrawer.style.display = 'block';
  }

  // Tornar acessível globalmente para os botões dos drawers
  window.cagpSelectGrafoNode = function (id) {
    selectNode(id);
  };

  if (resetGrafoBtn) {
    resetGrafoBtn.onclick = clearSelection;
  }
  if (closeDetailBtn) {
    closeDetailBtn.onclick = function () {
      if (detailDrawer) detailDrawer.style.display = 'none';
    };
  }

  // Atalho Escape no Grafo
  const grafoViewport = document.querySelector('.cagp-grafo-viewport');
  if (grafoViewport) {
    grafoViewport.onkeydown = function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        clearSelection();
      }
    };
  }

  // Filtros por Trilha Temática Oficial
  trilhaBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.onclick = function () {
      trilhaBtns.forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.remove('is-active', 'active');
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      });
      btn.classList.add('is-active', 'active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      activeTrilha = btn.getAttribute('data-trilha-filter') || 'all';

      clearSelection();
      const allNodes = Array.from(nodesGroup.querySelectorAll('.grafo-node'));
      allNodes.forEach(function (n) {
        const track = n.getAttribute('data-track');
        if (activeTrilha === 'all' || track === activeTrilha) {
          n.classList.remove('is-dimmed');
        } else {
          n.classList.add('is-dimmed');
        }
      });
    };
  });

  // Inicializar renderização do grafo SVG (evitando duplicação em navegação SPA)
  colsGroup.innerHTML = '';
  linksGroup.innerHTML = '';
  nodesGroup.innerHTML = '';
  initGrafo();

  /* 5. Sincronização Visual de "Minha Grade" nos Cards, Barra e Grafo SVG */
  const completedBadgeEl = document.getElementById('my-grade-completed-badge');
  const favBadgeEl = document.getElementById('my-grade-fav-badge');
  const hoursReadoutEl = document.getElementById('my-grade-hours-readout');
  const progressBarEl = document.getElementById('my-grade-progress-bar');
  const clearGradeBtn = document.getElementById('btn-clear-my-grade');

  function ensureDisciplineActionToolbar() {
    allDisciplines.forEach(function (disc) {
      const code = extractDiscCode(disc);
      const titleEl = disc.querySelector('summary strong');
      const fullTitle = (titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : code).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      const body = disc.querySelector('.cagp-discipline-body');
      if (!body || body.querySelector('.cagp-disc-toolbar')) return;
      const bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.className = 'cagp-disc-toolbar d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-2 pt-2 border-top';
      bar.innerHTML =
        '<button type="button" class="cagp-disc-action-chip" data-toggle-completed="' + code + '">' +
          '<i class="bi bi-check2-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span class="js-comp-label">Marcar como Já Cursada</span>' +
        '</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="cagp-disc-action-chip" data-open-disc-sheet="' + code + '">' +
          '<i class="bi bi-window-stack" aria-hidden="true"></i> Ficha no Bottom Sheet' +
        '</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="cagp-disc-action-chip" data-cagp-share="true" ' +
          'data-share-title="' + fullTitle + ' • Gestão Pública UFMG" ' +
          'data-share-text="Ementa oficial da disciplina obrigatória ' + fullTitle + ' no Portal CAGP UFMG:" ' +
          'data-share-url="percurso.html#explorador-grade">' +
          '<i class="bi bi-share" aria-hidden="true"></i> Compartilhar' +
        '</button>';
      body.appendChild(bar);
    });

    optCards.forEach(function (card) {
      const code = extractDiscCode(card);
      const titleEl = card.querySelector('summary strong');
      const fullTitle = (titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : code).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      const body = card.querySelector('.cagp-discipline-body');
      if (!body || body.querySelector('.cagp-disc-toolbar')) return;
      const bar = document.createElement('div');
      bar.className = 'cagp-disc-toolbar d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-2 pt-2 border-top';
      bar.innerHTML =
        '<button type="button" class="cagp-disc-action-chip" data-toggle-fav="' + code + '">' +
          '<i class="bi bi-star" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span class="js-fav-label">Favoritar Optativa ★</span>' +
        '</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="cagp-disc-action-chip" data-open-disc-sheet="' + code + '">' +
          '<i class="bi bi-window-stack" aria-hidden="true"></i> Ficha no Bottom Sheet' +
        '</button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="cagp-disc-action-chip" data-cagp-share="true" ' +
          'data-share-title="' + fullTitle + ' • Optativa Gestão Pública UFMG" ' +
          'data-share-text="Ementa oficial da disciplina optativa ' + fullTitle + ' no Portal CAGP UFMG:" ' +
          'data-share-url="percurso.html#catalogo-optativas">' +
          '<i class="bi bi-share" aria-hidden="true"></i> Compartilhar' +
        '</button>';
      body.appendChild(bar);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle-completed]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        window.cagpToggleGradeCompleted(btn.getAttribute('data-toggle-completed'));
      };
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle-fav]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        window.cagpToggleGradeFav(btn.getAttribute('data-toggle-fav'));
      };
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-open-disc-sheet]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.onclick = function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openDisciplineBottomSheet(btn.getAttribute('data-open-disc-sheet'));
      };
    });
  }

  function syncMyGradeUI() {
    let completedHours = 0;
    const validCompleted = gradeState.completed.filter(function (c) {
      if (DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[c]) {
        completedHours += DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO[c].ch || 60;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    });

    const compCount = validCompleted.length;
    const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((compCount / 27) * 100));
    const favCount = gradeState.favorites.length;

    if (completedBadgeEl) {
      if (window.cagpAnimateNumber) {
        window.cagpAnimateNumber(completedBadgeEl, compCount, {
          formatter: function (n) {
            const c = Math.round(n);
            const p = Math.min(100, Math.round((c / 27) * 100));
            return c + ' / 27 obrigatórias (' + p + '%)';
          }
        });
      } else {
        completedBadgeEl.textContent = compCount + ' / 27 obrigatórias (' + pct + '%)';
      }
    }
    if (favBadgeEl) {
      favBadgeEl.textContent = favCount + ' optativa' + (favCount === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' favorita' + (favCount === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' ★';
    }
    if (hoursReadoutEl) {
      if (window.cagpAnimateNumber) {
        window.cagpAnimateNumber(hoursReadoutEl, completedHours, { suffix: 'h / 1.860h concluídas' });
      } else {
        hoursReadoutEl.textContent = completedHours + 'h / 1.860h concluídas';
      }
    }
    if (progressBarEl) {
      if (window.cagpPulseProgress) {
        window.cagpPulseProgress(progressBarEl, pct);
      } else {
        progressBarEl.style.width = pct + '%';
      }
      progressBarEl.classList.toggle('is-complete', compCount >= 27);
    }
    if (clearGradeBtn) {
      clearGradeBtn.style.display = (compCount > 0 || favCount > 0) ? '' : 'none';
    }

    // Atualizar nós do Grafo SVG
    Object.keys(DISCIPLINAS_GRAFO).forEach(function (id) {
      const nodeEl = document.getElementById('node-' + id);
      if (nodeEl) {
        nodeEl.classList.toggle('is-completed', validCompleted.indexOf(id) !== -1);
      }
    });

    // Atualizar cards de obrigatórias
    allDisciplines.forEach(function (disc) {
      const code = extractDiscCode(disc);
      const isDone = validCompleted.indexOf(code) !== -1;
      disc.classList.toggle('is-completed', isDone);
      const btn = disc.querySelector('[data-toggle-completed]');
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.toggle('is-completed', isDone);
        const lbl = btn.querySelector('.js-comp-label');
        if (lbl) lbl.textContent = isDone ? 'Já Cursada ✓' : 'Marcar como Já Cursada';
      }
    });

    // Atualizar cards de optativas
    optCards.forEach(function (card) {
      const code = extractDiscCode(card);
      const isFav = gradeState.favorites.indexOf(code) !== -1;
      card.classList.toggle('is-favorite', isFav);
      const btn = card.querySelector('[data-toggle-fav]');
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.toggle('is-favorite', isFav);
        const lbl = btn.querySelector('.js-fav-label');
        if (lbl) lbl.textContent = isFav ? 'Optativa Favorita ★' : 'Favoritar Optativa ★';
      }
    });

    applyFilters();
    filterOptatives();
  }

  window.cagpToggleGradeCompleted = function (code) {
    const clean = (code || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (!clean) return;
    if (window.cagpHaptic) window.cagpHaptic(8);
    const idx = gradeState.completed.indexOf(clean);
    if (idx === -1) {
      gradeState.completed.push(clean);
    } else {
      gradeState.completed.splice(idx, 1);
    }
    saveGradeState();
    syncMyGradeUI();
  };

  window.cagpToggleGradeFav = function (code) {
    const clean = (code || '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (!clean) return;
    if (window.cagpHaptic) window.cagpHaptic(8);
    const idx = gradeState.favorites.indexOf(clean);
    if (idx === -1) {
      gradeState.favorites.push(clean);
    } else {
      gradeState.favorites.splice(idx, 1);
    }
    saveGradeState();
    syncMyGradeUI();
  };

  if (clearGradeBtn) {
    clearGradeBtn.onclick = function () {
      gradeState = { completed: [], favorites: [] };
      saveGradeState();
      syncMyGradeUI();
    };
  }

  function syncPercursoWithProfile() {
    try {
      let prof = null;
      if (window.cagpProfile && typeof window.cagpProfile.get === 'function') {
        prof = window.cagpProfile.get();
      } else {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem('cagp_student_profile_v1');
        if (raw) prof = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
      if (!prof) return;
      const curP = String(prof.period || '1').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') || '1';
      const curPOrd = curP + 'º';
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-period-filter], [data-filter-period]').forEach(function (btn) {
        const rawVal = btn.getAttribute('data-period-filter') || btn.getAttribute('data-filter-period') || '';
        const cleanVal = rawVal.replace(/º$/, '');
        if (cleanVal && cleanVal !== 'all') {
          btn.setAttribute('data-filter-period', cleanVal);
        }
        const isCur = (rawVal === curPOrd || cleanVal === curP);
        btn.classList.toggle('is-student-period', isCur);
        if (isCur) {
          btn.setAttribute('title', 'Seu período atual configurado no Passaporte Acadêmico (' + curP + 'º Período)');
        }
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.cagp-timeline-step, .cagp-period-block[data-period]').forEach(function (block) {
        block.classList.add('cagp-period-block');
        const marker = block.querySelector('.cagp-timeline-marker');
        const pVal = block.getAttribute('data-period') || (marker ? marker.textContent.trim().replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') : '');
        if (pVal) block.setAttribute('data-period', pVal);
        const isCur = pVal === curP;
        block.classList.toggle('is-student-current-period', isCur);
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler) {
    window.removeEventListener('cagp:vault-synced', window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler);
    window.removeEventListener('cagp:vault-cleared', window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler);
    window.removeEventListener('cagp:profile-updated', window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler);
  }
  window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler = function () {
    gradeState = loadGradeState();
    syncMyGradeUI();
    syncPercursoWithProfile();
  };
  window.addEventListener('cagp:vault-synced', window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler);
  window.addEventListener('cagp:vault-cleared', window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler);
  window.addEventListener('cagp:profile-updated', window.__cagpPercursoSyncHandler);

  ensureDisciplineActionToolbar();
  syncMyGradeUI();
  syncPercursoWithProfile();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initPercursoPage, { once: true });
  } else {
    initPercursoPage();
  }
})();
</script>
```
